name: Vice Extended
summary: Vice Extended is a global modification for Grand Theft Auto: Vice City that adds new gameplay mechanics and reworks existing ones to bring the game closer to later Grand Theft Auto titles. It adds climbing and swimming, a first-person view, drive-by shooting and movement while aiming, a reworked wanted system that lets the player hide from the police, GPS, vehicle tuning and new vehicles, extra weapons, a clothing store and wardrobe, a photo mode, save anywhere and autosave, and modloader support, alongside bug fixes and other quality-of-life changes.
